additional_requirements.title: Ensure all artifacts on all releases are signed
additional_requirements.text: For every artifact in every release, verify that all are properly signed.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure all external dependencies used in the build process are locked
additional_requirements.text: For all external dependencies being used in pipelines, verify they are locked.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure dependencies are validated before being used
additional_requirements.text: For every dependency used in every pipeline, validate each one.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure the build pipeline creates reproducible artifacts
additional_requirements.text: Create build pipelines that produce the same artifact given the same input (for example, artifacts that do not rely on timestamps).

additional_requirements.title: Ensure pipeline steps produce a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, configure it to produce a Software Bill of Materials on every run.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure pipeline steps sign the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) produced
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, configure it to sign its produced Software Bill of Materials on every run.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure all artifacts on all releases are signed (level 2)
additional_requirements.text: For every artifact in every release, verify that all are properly signed.
